payload.note: The exact quartic zero-fiber-score kernel is only linearly soft: at a quarter-period fixture K4 vanishes at p=0 but its exact external derivative is -1/3. Fixed UV boxes and positivity of the third Wiener chaos prove that the isolated free quartic-score square, normalized by N omega_L^2, grows at least as c L^2. Since g_L^4 is only logarithmically small on the tuned refinement trajectory, cubic RG matching alone cannot make this term uniform. This is a method obstruction, not interacting divergence: the complete order-g^4 coefficient contains signed score, Gibbs-density, normalization, projection, and higher-Taylor terms that may cancel the power sector. The active gate is their exact common-chaos assembly and cancellation decision, followed by a whole-composite annealed estimate and H^-1 shell sum.
